mapper.select: select r.semester_id as semesterId, sm.semester_name as semesterName, count(1) as courseCount, coalesce(round(avg(r.total_score),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(avg(r.grade_point),2),0) as avgGpa, coalesce(sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then ifnull(cl.credit,0) else 0 end),0) as creditEarned, sum(case when r.total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount from aem_grade_record r left join brm_semester sm on sm.semester_id = r.semester_id left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = r.course_id where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0' group by r.semester_id, sm.semester_name order by r.semester_id asc

select s.student_id as studentId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, s.enrollment_year as enrollmentYear, cl.class_name as className, mj.major_name as majorName from sam_student s left join brm_class cl on cl.class_id = s.class_id left join brm_major mj on mj.major_id = s.major_id where s.student_id = #{studentId}

select cl.course_id as courseId, cl.course_code as courseCode, cl.course_name as courseName, cl.credit as credit, cl.course_category as courseCategory, count(1) as takeCount, coalesce(round(avg(r.total_score),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(avg(r.grade_point),2),0) as avgGpa, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as passRate, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as excellentRate, sum(case when r.total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount from aem_grade_record r join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = r.course_id where r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0' and r.semester_id = #{semesterId} group by cl.course_id, cl.course_code, cl.course_name, cl.credit, cl.course_category having count(1) >= 1 order by avgScore asc

select s.student_id as studentId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, cl.class_name as className, count(1) as courseCount, coalesce(round(avg(r.total_score),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(avg(r.grade_point),2),0) as avgGpa, sum(case when r.total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount from aem_grade_record r join sam_student s on s.student_id = r.student_id left join brm_class cl on cl.class_id = s.class_id where r.semester_id = #{semesterId} and r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0' and s.class_id = #{classId} group by s.student_id, s.student_no, s.student_name, cl.class_name order by failCount desc, avgScore asc

select coalesce(round(avg(r.total_score),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(avg(r.grade_point),2),0) as avgGpa, sum(case when r.total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, coalesce(sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then ifnull(cl.credit,0) else 0 end),0) as creditEarned, count(distinct r.semester_id) as semesterCount from aem_grade_record r left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = r.course_id where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0'
